title: app-shell previews/FlowCanvas.test.tsx escapes to the real network (ECONNRESET/"socket hang up" noise, different mechanism than #4688/#4697)
body:
Found while verifying objectui#4697's acceptance criteria (measuring the full `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` suite before/after that fix). objectui#4697's own card anticipated this: "a remainder from yet another probe is a NEW finding, not this card's."

## Mechanism (different from both #4688 and #4697)

Both prior cards were `ECONNREFUSED` from a plain `fetch()` (a `MetadataClient` call in #4697's case, the grid's explain probe in #4688's). This one is a **different error code entirely** — `ECONNRESET` / `Error: socket hang up` — which is what Node's http client throws when a connection is aborted mid-flight, not "nobody is listening." That points at a different transport shape (e.g. a long-lived/streaming connection torn down on unmount) rather than a plain one-shot `fetch()` rejection.

## Measured (worktree `objectui-issue-4697`, on top of objectui#4697's own fix, commit `b65801b2d`)

Bisected the same way #4697 bisected its own 180: ran `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` in full (167 files, 1671 passed | 1 skipped — no assertion failures either before or after isolating this), saw 20 `ECONNRESET` lines that #4697's fix does not touch, then binary-searched by directory/file:

- `views/metadata-admin/inspectors/` (the 9 files objectui#4697 fixed) → 0 (confirms #4697's fix is clean)
- `views/metadata-admin/previews/` (20 files) → 20
- Isolated `previews/FlowCanvas.test.tsx` alone (`pnpm exec vitest run … --maxWorkers=1`) → **19** `ECONNRESET` lines, exit 0 (all assertions pass; every other file in `previews/` → 0)

Like #4688/#4697, this does not fail any test — `FlowCanvas.tsx`/`FlowCanvas.test.tsx` don't reference `useMetadataClient`, `fetch`, `WebSocket`, or `EventSource` directly in their own source, so the escaping call is coming from something `FlowCanvas.tsx` imports transitively; not root-caused further here (out of scope for the card that surfaced it).

## Suggested direction

Same shape as #3339/#4105/#4688/#4697: trace the transitive import that opens the connection (start from what `FlowCanvas.tsx` renders/imports beyond the flow-canvas-layout pure helpers) and either stub it in the test or make the hook it comes from skip the connection when no host/adapter is present — whichever precedent fits once the actual call site is found.

## Provenance

Measured in worktree `objectui-issue-4697` (branch `claude/issue-4697-metadata-client-doubles`) while verifying objectui#4697, on top of `b65801b2d`.
